notes: 44 of 51 episodes succeeded, counting every episode run this session across all controller versions and bag positions. The 7 failures were 6 misses with bags 0.45 m or more away (hand reach limit) and 1 fall on the practice bag with an over-aggressive 5 cm CoM lean that I then reduced. The final right-hand punch controller succeeded in 20/20 seeds on the practice bag (0.38,-0.15,1; swing 34-39 cm, max tilt under 4 deg). It is weaker on far bags: in the final-version far-bag tests, 0.45,-0.05,0.9 and 0.5,-0.1,1 failed.
